title: Read an item
summary: Fetches one item a search found (a paper, a study or an article): its title, authors, date, text or abstract and link, from the source it came from.
whenToUse: Use after a search, on the single best match: the one whose title and abstract are really about the topic, not the first result.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: The item's id or address from the search, or its number in the list, such as 2

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: The source the id came from; leave empty when it is the same as the search

example: Read paper 2410.15285 and tell me what it found
_note: `aliases` keeps the AG.2 argument name working: a planner that learned `arxivID` still lands on `id`. Phase AV.11 (2026-11-10): offered whenever the chat has a numbered list from an earlier turn, so 'write up 2' can read item 2.
